newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-DESAILLY EXTENDS CONTRACT WITH AC MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DESAILLY EXTENDS CONTRACT WITH AC MILAN.

text.p: French international midfielder Marcel Desailly said on Friday he had signed a one-year extension to his contract with AC Milan in a deal that would keep him in Italy until the year 2000.
"I'll stay at Milan until 2000, I've just signed a one-year extension to my contract," he told reporters.
Desailly had been linked to Atletico Madrid but he said he wanted to stay at Milan, who made him an improved deal, although less than the Spaniards were offering.
"I preferred to earn less but stay at Milan. I'm fine here and I can still be successful," the 28-year-old said.
